snippet.title: South Scrimshaw Part 2 Teaser Trailer – Winter 2025
snippet.description:
🐳2️⃣ South Scrimshaw Part 2 is now scheduled for end of year.

I know both people's patience and attention are finite and I apologize for how long it has been taking. I am still hard at work every available day, and work is going well, but I haven't wanted to sacrifice quality for a speedier release.

Thank you everyone for the support so far. Even if painting is a slow process I am trying to do better than my best and I hope it eventually meets expectations.
